review.reviewBody:
I've been to Japan almost 20 times, and I realized I've never been to Mount Fuji. This time I had more time, so I dedicated a day to it. Summer isn't the best season for Mount Fuji, and it's crowded during summer vacation. Therefore, I arranged a day to hire a car to preview the nearby attractions, and if there are any I like, I'll focus on them next time.

Lake Kawaguchi is beautiful; I'd love to come back. Mount Fuji covered in snow in winter must be stunning.

My child doesn't like hot springs, so we didn't go to Hakone. Instead, we went shopping at an outlet mall, but it was incredibly crowded on the weekend.

The driver and I are from the same hometown, and we chatted happily about our hometowns the whole way.

I highly recommend hiring a car. It saves time, at least a whole day for visiting these attractions. The transportation costs for four people plus one night's accommodation are less expensive than hiring a car; you don't have to rush around, and you won't be tired after a long day.

comments.productName: Solo friendly 1-day tour from Tokyo to Mount Fuji: outlet shopping, twin lakes sightseeing & Hikawa clock shop | optional 9-person group
comments.comment: The driver and tour guide, Xiao Cheng, were incredibly responsible. From the moment we picked them up, they provided detailed guidance throughout the trip. Even though the elderly gentleman and lady in our group weren't interested in shopping at the outlet mall, the tour guide immediately offered to help them find photo spots near Mount Fuji, and to find comfortable places to eat and relax, without showing any impatience. On our return trip, we opted not to join the tour back to Tokyo, but instead found a hotel at the foot of Mount Fuji to enjoy a hot spring bath. The driver even took us to the hotel before leaving, as getting a taxi is very difficult despite Mount Fuji being a famous tourist attraction. We were extremely grateful to him. For those traveling from Tokyo to Mount Fuji, I highly recommend this day tour; it saves a lot of hassle, and the small group size makes it very convenient.
comments.originalContent: 司机大哥和导游小程非常负责任，从上门接上开始，一路都是各种细节指引，同行的老先生老太太对奥莱逛街没兴趣，导游小姐姐也是第一时间表示可以陪他们找富士山打卡地方拍照，找哪里好吃地方舒服坐坐，一点都没有不耐烦。我们返程时不跟团回东京，就在富士山脚下找个酒店泡温泉，最后司机大哥还特地把我们送到酒店再走，因为富士山虽然是著名景点，可是自己打车却非常困难，实在是非常感谢司机大哥了。从东京来富士山，强烈建议报这个一日游，省了很多麻烦，而且小团，行动起来也很方便。

comments.productName: [Guaranteed Departure] Nikko Autumn Foliage : Kegon Falls+Toshogu+Lake Chuzenji+Shinkyo Bridge Day Tour(From Tokyo)
comments.comment: I wanted to see the autumn leaves in Nikko, but unfortunately many trees hadn't turned red yet; next week might be the best time to see them. Our guide, Juna, explained the history and cultural value of the sites clearly in both Chinese and English, and also arranged the itinerary well. Juna specifically arranged to visit Toshogu Shrine first, then Shinbashi Bridge, so we wouldn't have to climb the stairs from Shinbashi Bridge to Toshogu. We wanted to visit Tokugawa Ieyasu's mausoleum at Toshogu, which requires climbing 200 steps and then returning to the meeting point. If the order of visits were reversed, visiting Tokugawa Ieyasu's mausoleum would require climbing the stairs twice, which sounded exhausting.
comments.originalContent: 想去日光看紅葉，遺憾很多樹尚未變紅，下周或許才是最佳觀賞期。導遊Juna中英雙語清晰講解景點的歷史及文化價值，也合理安排行程。Juna特意安排先去東照宮之後才去神橋，這樣我們便不需要從神橋上樓梯到東照宮。因為我們想要在東照宮參觀德川家康的陵寢，需要走200級樓梯上去，再原路下樓梯返回集合地點。如果參觀次序對調，想參觀德川家康的陵寢便需要上兩次樓梯，想想都累。

comments.productName: Tokyo Departure: Mount Fuji Private Vehicle Charter with English-Speaking Driver | Customizable Itinerary | Contact Us for Other Destinations (e.g., Hakone, Kamakura, Izu, Nikko, Karuizawa, Hakuba, Tokyo, Yokohama) Mount Fuji Day Tour Trip
comments.comment:
I've been to Japan almost 20 times, and I realized I've never been to Mount Fuji. This time I had more time, so I dedicated a day to it. Summer isn't the best season for Mount Fuji, and it's crowded during summer vacation. Therefore, I arranged a day to hire a car to preview the nearby attractions, and if there are any I like, I'll focus on them next time.

Lake Kawaguchi is beautiful; I'd love to come back. Mount Fuji covered in snow in winter must be stunning.

My child doesn't like hot springs, so we didn't go to Hakone. Instead, we went shopping at an outlet mall, but it was incredibly crowded on the weekend.

The driver and I are from the same hometown, and we chatted happily about our hometowns the whole way.

I highly recommend hiring a car. It saves time, at least a whole day for visiting these attractions. The transportation costs for four people plus one night's accommodation are less expensive than hiring a car; you don't have to rush around, and you won't be tired after a long day.
comments.originalContent:
来日本快20次了，发现自己居然没去过富士山。这次时间长，于是安排一天。夏季不是富士山最美的季节，暑假游客也多。所以，安排了一天包车，先都把附近景点都预习一遍，如果有喜欢的，作为下次的重点。
河口湖很漂亮，可以再来。冬天富士山上覆盖白雪，应该很美。
孩子不喜欢泡温泉，于是没去箱根，安排了奥莱购物，赶上周末人好多呀。
司导和我是老乡，一路开开心心的说说老家的事。

对于包车，我真的推荐，一路省时间，去这些景点，至少节约一天时间。j4个人的交通费+一天住宿费，不如包车，这样不用奔波赶车，一天下来也不累。
